schema_conventions.notation: All listed fields required; suffix ? means explicit null allowed, not omission. Types and cross-field rules in Markdown section 7.
schema_conventions.Id: nonempty ASCII string max120; no path components
schema_conventions.Instant: RFC3339 with timezone and up to 6 fractional digits; compare UTC integer microseconds
schema_conventions.CandidateRef: {manifest:Ref,external_race_key:string}; must reference the earlier CANDIDATES_LOCKED manifest and its target race in the same run/JST day, never the later prediction-lock manifest
schema_conventions.capture evidence: {capture_id:Id,source:string,raw:Seal,private_ref:string,method:string,source_status:string,parser_version:Id,fetched_at:Instant,saved_at:Instant}; use only existing acquired evidence, no fabricated references
schema_conventions.nullable_rule: Every null that denotes unavailable evidence needs a paired reason; normal parent_epoch=null at genesis is explicitly allowed.

offline_implementation_profile.synthetic_guard: APP_ENV=testing; recorded dedicated temporary fixture root; all artificial captures and initial history files within that root. A label alone does not authorize real2026.
offline_implementation_profile.no_approval_forgery: Offline validation_run.approval_receipt=null with explicit scope and real_execution_authorized=false; never a real approval receipt.
offline_implementation_profile.artifact_source_row: ARTIFACT source_ref/row_ref/execution_uuid/calculation_version/input_hash; source_run_id/source_result_id=null and source_kind=ARTIFACT (DB IDs not applicable), original race/entry/player IDs unchanged.
offline_implementation_profile.canonical_serialization: CHRONOLOGICAL-JSON-OBJECT-KEYS-v1; object keys sorted, list order and null/type retained
offline_implementation_profile.run_index: HEADER has days=[]; separate immutable RUN_INDEX references header and completed day locks; no future refs or header mutation.
offline_implementation_profile.receipt: RESULTS_OPENED is an immutable day_manifest version with day_lock and opened_at; the earlier lock remains unchanged; no self receipt reference.

input_bundle.history_used: offline event source identities and hashes

offline_implementation_profile.history_event: material_kind, full original race/meeting/schedule identity and context, complete roster with original entry/player/external/bike/score and official rank/status/method, source_id, verified version, logical_available_from (JST date), input_fetched_at/fetched_at/saved_at/confirmed_at?; epoch-listed sources only.
offline_implementation_profile.bounded_processing: stream one history race per JSONL row (max1MiB); per-target person histories max4096 and selected audit races max8192; stop when current history working memory exceeds96MiB, without trimming. Bundle payload max4MiB and graph payload cache max1MiB per verification call, never retained across calls. PHP verification runs have memory_limit=128M.
offline_implementation_profile.source_times: Actual post-event acquisition timestamps remain actual timestamps, never proof of historical availability.
offline_implementation_profile.input_quality: Known invalid STAT01 raw/anchor may remain in the sealed normal capture/input audit and NO_PREDICTION retains that Ref; never sent to the predictor or converted to zero.
offline_implementation_profile.prediction_ids: dYYYYMMDD + first12hex(SHA256(external_race_key)) + input/p0/p1 suffix; deterministic inside the single immutable run root, not fake source DB IDs.
offline_implementation_profile.corrections: Append CORRECTED result with prior-result Ref, new evaluation and explicit unprocessed-future-day epoch; do not mutate earlier input/lock/evaluation.

acceptance_cases.expect: Result fetch called zero times before day lock verifies non-null terminal bundle refs for all T x both methods; technical unprocessed blocks opening; a reason index alone never suffices.
Changing only target-day/future outcomes cannot alter earlier or same-day input/prediction hashes.
Forbidden result fields rejected; year is never forged as 2025 to bypass validation.

Equal scheduled times/restarts preserve epoch, original IDs, entrant order and terminal PREDICTED/NO_PREDICTION bundles; JST event_day < target_day and logical_available_from <= target_day plus fixed-epoch and feature cutoffs are all required.
Known Men 5-9 accepted; Girls/L excluded; Unknown never treated as Men; score comes from detail, not empty list field.
Any invalid anchor makes entire C1 race NO_PREDICTION without dropping that entrant; valid mean anchor zero retained.
Known unavailable signals/history preserve null and reasons; observed zeros distinct; unknown exceptions FAILED.

Each method seals a prediction bundle before results. PREDICTED requires valid input; NO_PREDICTION may have input=null only for known inability to construct normal input. Both reference an earlier candidate manifest and actual capture evidence (or empty array plus missing-evidence reasons); day lock -> terminal bundle -> earlier candidate manifest is acyclic. Results retain both terminal refs.
Hand examples give 1/3 ordered, 2/3 each position and 2/3 set; plus tie/no-pred gives 4/5 coverage and unchanged E=3. T=1/P=0/N=1/U=0 gives coverage=0, E=E_pair=0 and accuracy=null, never 0%.
Top3 tie/cancellation/zero denominator excluded with reasons; lower-only ties and abnormal losers with unique top3 remain eligible.
Correction creates new result/evaluation/forward epoch; predictions and first evaluation stay immutable.

Same ID different input/model/result is CONFLICT; partial files/failure evidence retained; no permanent deletion. Re-prediction after result open is forbidden even with a new ID; verified reuse of original terminal bundles and epoch for result/evaluation resume is allowed.
New adapter matches frozen arithmetic on limited 2022-2025 inputs without using outcomes for predictions; no refit/rebin.
Legacy CLI still rejects 2026; old artifacts load under unchanged Contract::plan; start/end source seals unchanged.
